title.zh: 比特币先驱Adam Back旗下多项业务受挫：BSTR被要求支付1500万美元“分手”费
title.en: 比特币先驱Adam Back旗下多项业务受挫：BSTR被要求支付1500万美元“分手”费

current_state.zh: Adam Back's affiliated bitcoin businesses are under pressure as BSTR Holdings' SPAC merger collapsed with a $15M breakup fee, Blockstream Mining faces litigation with Exacore over unpaid equipment, power and customer deposits tied to ~$2B in financing, and the Liquid Network hack left roughly $47M with the attacker after most of the 4,000 stolen BTC was returned.
